METHOD AND EVIDENCE

What these results measure

A fixed sample

FEHD provides the sampling frame. Twenty pilot branches comprise five per district. The provisional main sample has 25 per district. Sampling precedes external-source matching; missing matches remain in the study.

Inspectable matching

Name, address and available location evidence contribute to a documented score. Scores are heuristic, not probabilities. Close alternatives and duplicate assignments require review.

Explicit denominators

Field agreement is calculated only where both linked records provide comparable values. Missing fields and uncertain entity links are reported separately. Link selection can bias observed agreement.

Human verification pending

Two group members must independently label candidate pairs. Calibration and held-out branches are separate. Matching precision, recall and F1 remain unavailable until reference labels exist.

Snapshot provenance and source limits

FEHD licensing is not a daily operating-status measure. Overture operating status is not opening hours. OSM tags are optional. Different address text may still identify the same premises.
